title: Larkspur Valuables Floater Renewal Calendar and Nonrenewal Thresholds
content:
Larkspur Valuables Floater renewal calendar. Every floater is a twelve-month term; the tier fixes when the renewal is billed, how much advance notice a nonrenewal gets, and the theft claim count and lookback window that bear on renewal.

| Tier | Renewal offer lead time: renewal billed this many calendar days before expiration | Minimum advance notice of nonrenewal (calendar days) | Paid theft or mysterious disappearance claims at which the floater is nonrenewed (count) | Claims lookback window (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 45 | 30 | 2 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 45 | 30 | 2 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 45 | 30 | 2 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 45 | 30 | 3 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 45 | 30 | 3 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 60 | 30 | 3 | 5 |

## Reading the calendar

- **Renewal offer lead time.** The Private Client tier is billed for renewal 60 calendar days before expiration; every other tier 45.
- **Nonrenewal notice.** Every tier gives at least 30 calendar days of advance notice of nonrenewal.
- **Theft claim count.** The Classic, Select and Preferred tiers turn on a count of 2; the Prestige, Collector and Private Client tiers on 3.
- **Lookback.** The claims lookback window is 5 years on every tier.

## Hypothetical calendar

A hypothetical Valuables Floater Preferred expiring on 30 September is billed for renewal 45 calendar days earlier, on 16 August; a Valuables Floater Private Client expiring the same day is billed 60 calendar days earlier, on 1 August.
